header: A real excerpt, a fade, and then the ask
subheader: A visual boundary — not an access check.
bodytext:
The excerpt is ordinary editorial rich text. It is capped in height and faded at the foot with a gradient that ends in whatever tone the band is standing on, so the boundary reads as a boundary rather than as a cut-off paragraph.

What the gate is not

Everything written here is rendered into the page and served to every reader and every crawler. The fade sits over text that is already present and hides it from nobody who looks at the source, which is why only text that may legitimately be public belongs in this field.

Access control stays with TYPO3's own access rules on the page the button points at. This element draws the line; it does not
note: The note is the sentence that asks — who gets the rest, and how somebody without access can still get at it.
